notes: Cambridge INT 4e Ch.14 LO 14-4 (DEMO 14-4) method. Commissions of $1,200 are capitalized into cost, so original cost = 6,000 x $15.50 + $1,200 = $94,200. Loss/gain answers are reported as positive magnitudes and named LOSS or GAIN in the label: Year 1 unrealized loss $10,200, Year 2 unrealized gain $2,400, net holding-period loss $7,800 = $86,400 proceeds - $94,200 cost. At sale the FVA has a $7,800 CREDIT balance, so it is DEBITED to eliminate it, and no separate gain or loss on sale is recorded because the fair value change was already recognized.
